mapper.insert: insert into deal_message (deal_id, sender_id, receiver_id, content, is_read) values (#{dealId}, #{senderId}, #{receiverId}, #{content}, 0)
mapper.select: select m.*, u.nickname as senderNickname, r.nickname as receiverNickname from deal_message m left join `user` u on m.sender_id = u.id left join `user` r on m.receiver_id = r.id where m.deal_id = #{dealId} order by m.created_at asc, m.id asc
mapper.update: update deal_message set is_read = 1 where deal_id = #{dealId} and receiver_id = #{receiverId} and is_read = 0
mapper.select: select count(*) from deal_message where receiver_id = #{userId} and is_read = 0
